name: Flattop to Ptarmigan ridge traverse

legs.route: Flattop Mountain trail from the trailhead
Ridge over the intermediate points, then the west ridge of Ptarmigan with cairned route-finding near the top
legs.connect: Follow the ridge southeast over Peak 2, Peak 3 and a false summit, then drop to the pass before the final climb.

how: Climb the busy Flattop trail, then continue along the broken ridge over the unnamed bumps to the saddle below Ptarmigan. The last section up Ptarmigan is steep, with narrow ridge and loose rock, so some scrambling and a few cairns guide the way. The alternative approach to Ptarmigan along the valley avoids the ridge entirely.
descent: Return from the pass across open tundra to a valley trail, then walk out to the road. This forms a loop instead of retracing the ridge.
logistics: Parking is at a trailhead off the hillside roads; fee status varies. A bike along the valley road is another way to reach the base of Ptarmigan. Weather moves in fast and the peak has had fatal accidents on its mountaineering lines.
notes: Only two sources read in full. A SummitPost log seen in search results calls the ridge class 4 but the page returned 403; the Hiking Project page gives no class. Trailhead naming differs between pages (Backside Flattop vs Rabbit Lake), so left vague.
